name: Budget phase
description: Where in the budget cycle a figure comes from, as defined by the Fiscal Data Package. This is the field publishers most often omit and the one that matters most: a proposed figure and an executed figure for the same line are different numbers describing different things, and comparing them without knowing which is which produces nonsense.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Proposed
hasDefinedTerm.description: As put forward by the executive, before the legislature has acted.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Approved
hasDefinedTerm.description: As adopted by the legislature. The legally binding appropriation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Adjusted
hasDefinedTerm.description: Approved, then amended in-year by supplementary appropriation or transfer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Executed
hasDefinedTerm.description: What was actually spent or received. Typically final only after audit.
